1.title: This new bridge aimed to show US-Canada unity but instead stoked divisions
1.summary: A bridge linking Michigan to Ontario is about to open but Canada disinvited US dignitaries from Friday's ceremony.

2.title: NBA superstar LeBron James to join Philadelphia 76ers
2.summary: Basketball superstar LeBron James announces he will join the Philadelphia 76ers for what he says will be his final contract in the NBA.

3.title: Teen pleads guilty in school shooting in Georgia that killed four
3.summary: Colt Gray was 14 when he shot and killed four people and injured nine others. He faces a life sentence.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Netanyahu Says He Will Meet With Trump, as U.S.-Iran Strikes Continue
4.summary: News of the meeting, the leaders’ first in five months, came after U.S. forces conducted the 13th consecutive night of attacks on Iran. Iran launched drone strikes at U.S. targets in the Gulf.

5.title: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
5.summary: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.

6.title: 6 Killed in West Bank Shooting, Officials Say, Among the Deadliest in Months
6.summary: The authorities said four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed in the incident. The details of events remain unclear, with officials giving differing accounts.
